title: DNNs, Dataset Statistics, and Correlation Functions
abstract: arXiv:2511.21715v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper argues that dataset structure is important in image recognition tasks (among other tasks). Specifically, we focus on the nature and genesis of correlational structure in the actual datasets upon which DNNs are trained. We argue that DNNs are implementing a widespread methodology in condensed matter physics and materials science that focuses on mesoscale correlation structures that live between fundamental atomic/molecular scales and continuum scales. Specifically, we argue that DNNs that are successful in image classification must be discovering high order correlation functions. It is well-known that DNNs successfully generalize in apparent contravention of standard statistical learning theory. We consider the implications of our discussion for this puzzle.

translated_title: 深度神经网络、数据集统计与关联函数
translated_abstract: 本文论证了数据集结构在图像识别任务（以及其他任务）中的重要性。具体而言，我们聚焦于深度神经网络（DNN）训练所用的实际数据集中关联结构的本质与起源。我们认为，DNN正在实现凝聚态物理和材料科学中一种广泛使用的方法论，该方法论关注介于基本原子/分子尺度与连续介质尺度之间的介观关联结构。具体来说，我们认为在图像分类中取得成功的DNN必然是在发现高阶关联函数。众所周知，DNN能够成功泛化，这似乎与标准统计学习理论相悖。我们探讨了本文的讨论对这一谜题的启示。
tldr: 本文提出在图像分类中成功的深度神经网络实际上是在发现数据集中的介观高阶关联结构，这类似于凝聚态物理与材料科学的方法论，并由此为DNN泛化能力与标准统计学习理论之间的矛盾提供了新的解释视角。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that successful DNNs in image classification work by discovering mesoscale high-order correlation structures in datasets—a methodology analogous to condensed matter physics and materials science—thereby offering a new perspective on why DNNs generalize despite apparent contradictions with standard statistical learning theory.
